subject: RMS lifts Ore Reserves 79% to 4.3Moz, WGX lifts Meekatharra to 2.9Mtpa
lead: Ramelius' FY26 Resources and Reserves Statement dominated the window, with Mineral Resources up 17% to 260Mt at 1.7g/t Au for 14Moz and Ore Reserves up 79% to 70Mt at 1.9g/t Au for 4.3Moz, driven by maiden reserves at Never Never and Roe. Westgold's scoping study on a brownfields expansion of the Meekatharra processing hub, lifting throughput 61% to 2.9Mtpa and adding about A$1.1 billion in project NPV at A$5,500/oz gold, was the other standout of the day.
subtitle: Reserve growth and a hub expansion overshadow a run of drilling updates across the gold watchlist.
watch_items: RMS: updated production and cost outlook to FY30 due September 2026
BTR: assays from Two Mile Hill deep holes due late September 2026, with two more holes remaining in the ~3,400m program
YRL: two further diamond tail results from Arrakis expected early September 2026
PC2: trading halt to lift on the earlier of normal trading resuming 27 August 2026 or the capital raising announcement
DTM: shareholder meeting on Yamarna consideration options expected 30 September 2026, with securities proposed to issue 5 October 2026
WGX: potential investment decision on Meekatharra expansion expected late FY27
day_in_brief: Resources and reserves: Ramelius' 2026 statement showed Mineral Resources up 17% to 260Mt at 1.7g/t Au for 14Moz and Ore Reserves up 79% to 70Mt at 1.9g/t Au for 4.3Moz, with growth driven by maiden reserves at Never Never (6.8Mt at 7.4g/t Au for 1.6Moz) and Roe (4.4Mt at 1.8g/t Au for 260koz) plus FY26 drilling that added 1.8Moz Au at a discovery cost of ~A$55/oz. The company's investor presentation also confirmed FY26 underlying EBITDA of A$765.4 million, underlying NPAT of A$319.9 million, and cash and gold on hand of A$649.6 million, with FY27 exploration targeting 850,000oz to 1,600,000oz at 1.9g/t to 2.4g/t Au. Studies and development: Westgold's scoping study lifts Meekatharra throughput from 1.8Mtpa to 2.9Mtpa, adding about 47kozpa for total production of 1.6Moz over 10 years, with indicative capital of A$65 million to A$100 million, a 9-month payback and roughly A$1.1 billion added to project NPV at A$5,500/oz gold. Drilling: Gum Creek assays confirmed an 800m southern extension at Howards and 6m @ 12.67g/t Au from 114m (including 1m @ 58.70g/t Au) at Heron South, while Yandal's Arrakis discovery returned 17.5m @ 2.3g/t Au from 127.5m and 17.0m @ 1.1g/t Au from 162.0m, defining a third high-grade domain within the 1.3km system. At Sandstone, Bellevue Gold's deep holes at Two Mile Hill logged 400m to 500m of mineralised tonalite with 53 visible gold occurrences, both ending in mineralisation and now interpreted at over 300m horizontal thickness, open below 700m. Exploration targets and project reviews: Corazon Mining defined a maiden Exploration Target at Two Pools of 1.4Mt to 2.15Mt at 1.6g/t to 1.9g/t Au for approximately 72,000oz to 132,000oz, with further RC drilling planned over the next six months. Dart Mining compiled 150 historic drill holes at Walwa, identifying two priority tin targets against historic estimates of 8.64Mt @ 0.163% Sn and a higher-grade zone of 993,000t @ 0.38% Sn, with diamond drilling due to start in October 2026. Corporate: PC Gold entered a trading halt pending a capital raising announcement, to lift on the earlier of normal trading resuming on 27 August 2026 or the announcement's release. Dart Mining separately detailed plans to issue 18,823,532 options at A$0.011 as consideration for its Yamarna gold project acquisition, subject to shareholder approval expected 30 September 2026.

summaries.heading: Ramelius lifts Ore Reserves 79% and Mineral Resources 17%
summaries.body: Ramelius' 2026 Resources and Reserves Statement shows Mineral Resources up 17% to 260Mt at 1.7g/t Au for 14Moz, and Ore Reserves up 79% to 70Mt at 1.9g/t Au for 4.3Moz. Growth was driven by maiden Ore Reserves at Never Never (6.8Mt at 7.4g/t Au for 1.6Moz) and Roe (4.4Mt at 1.8g/t Au for 260koz), plus FY26 drilling that added 1.8Moz Au at 1.5g/t Au at a discovery cost of ~A$55/oz. An updated production and cost outlook to FY30 is due in September 2026.

summaries.heading: Ramelius lifts Ore Reserves 79% and Resources 17% in FY26 update
summaries.body: Ramelius' FY26 investor presentation confirms Mineral Resources of 14.0Moz at 1.7g/t (up 17% year-on-year after depletion) and Ore Reserves of 4.3Moz at 1.9g/t (up 79%). FY26 underlying EBITDA reached A$765.4 million with underlying NPAT of A$319.9 million, and cash and gold on hand stood at A$649.6 million. FY27 exploration targets 850,000oz to 1,600,000oz at 1.9g/t to 2.4g/t Au, with FY27 guidance due in September 2026.

summaries.heading: High-grade RC results extend Heron South, Howards and Melbourne Bitter
summaries.body: Final assay results from RC drilling at Gum Creek's Howards, Heron South and Melbourne Bitter prospects have confirmed an 800m southern extension to mineralisation at Howards, with Heron South returning 6m @ 12.67g/t Au from 114m including 1m @ 58.70g/t Au from 114m. Melbourne Bitter drilling points to resource expansion potential south of the existing 0.48Mt @ 1.39g/t Au resource. Follow-up RC and diamond drilling is planned at all three prospects ahead of updated resource estimates later in 2026.

summaries.heading: Visible gold logged through 500m tonalite at Two Mile Hill
summaries.body: Two deep diamond holes at the Sandstone Project's Two Mile Hill deposit intersected 400m to 500m of mineralised tonalite, with 53 visible gold occurrences logged, mostly in quartz veins with galena and pyrite. Both holes ended in mineralised tonalite, extended beyond planned depth, with the unit now interpreted at over 300m horizontal thickness and open below 700m. Two Mile Hill-Shillington currently hosts 731koz @ 1.6g/t Au; assays are due late September 2026, with two more holes remaining in the ~3,400m program.

summaries.heading: Corazon defines maiden gold Exploration Target at Two Pools
summaries.body: Corazon Mining has defined a maiden Exploration Target of 1.4Mt to 2.15Mt at 1.6g/t to 1.9g/t Au for approximately 72,000oz to 132,000oz of contained gold at its 100% owned Two Pools Gold Project in Western Australia. The Northern Target is most advanced, defined by around 92 drillholes, while Central and Southern areas remain under-drilled with spacing up to 200m. A further ~5,000m RC drilling program is planned over the next six months to test the target and support future Mineral Resource estimation.

summaries.heading: Westgold outlines brownfields expansion of Meekatharra processing hub
summaries.body: Westgold's scoping study lifts Meekatharra throughput from 1.8Mtpa to 2.9Mtpa (a 61% increase), adding about 47kozpa for total production of 1.6Moz over 10 years. Indicative capital is A$65 million to A$100 million with a 9-month payback, and project NPV improves by about A$1.1 billion at A$5,500/oz gold. Feasibility work is underway ahead of a potential investment decision in late FY27.

summaries.heading: Dart Mining defines two priority drill targets at Walwa tin project
summaries.body: Dart Mining has compiled and verified 150 historic drill holes (7,672m) at its Walwa tin-tantalum project in Victoria, identifying two high-priority targets: a larger high-grade greisen zone 400m to 600m below surface, and repeating mineralised dykes indicated by seismic survey below known workings. Historic pre-JORC estimates include 8.64Mt @ 0.163% Sn and a higher-grade zone of 993,000t @ 0.38% Sn. Diamond drilling of the targets is expected to start in October 2026.

summaries.heading: New high-grade domain confirmed at Arrakis gold discovery
summaries.body: Yandal Resources has returned further infill RC and diamond results from the Arrakis discovery within its Ironstone Well-Barwidgee project, including 17.5m @ 2.3g/t Au from 127.5m and 17.0m @ 1.1g/t Au from 162.0m in 26IWBRC0121D, located about 50m down-dip of the earlier 6m @ 28.3g/t Au hit reported on 10 August 2026. The results define a third high-grade domain within the 1.3km Arrakis system, with the down-plunge extension below the Yueh Shear Zone remaining untested. Two further diamond tail results are expected in early September 2026.

summaries.heading: PC Gold halted ahead of capital raising news
summaries.body: PC Gold has entered a trading halt at its own request pending an announcement on a capital raising. The halt will lift on the earlier of normal trading resuming on 27 August 2026 or the raising announcement being released.

summaries.heading: Dart Mining details consideration options for Yamarna deal
summaries.body: Dart Mining plans to issue 18,823,532 options exercisable at A$0.011, expiring 30 September 2029, as consideration for the previously announced Yamarna gold project acquisition. The issue requires shareholder approval at a meeting expected on 30 September 2026, with securities proposed to be issued on 5 October 2026.
